notes: INSIDE half of the Leech Laser (unique, gold trim): a glass siphon tank whose green fluid rises with the charge (frame 5 = full, strip green), the thick power-tap cable from the coupling, repair hatch. fire: the tank drains in a flash. damaged: tank glass cracked, cable frayed and sparking; disabled: tank dark and split, cable torn out. Barrel layer leech_laser_barrel: a laser barrel with the siphon coil wrapped round it (green and gold) and a power-tap cable looped under it.
